build_crystal_from_cif: build a crystal structure from a CIF string with optional Niggli reduction and primitive cell extraction
build_crystal_graph: build a crystal graph with edge indices and fractional coordinates using the CrystalNN local environment strategy
convert_frac_to_cart_coords: convert fractional coordinates to Cartesian coordinates using lattice lengths and angles with periodic boundary regularization
compute_pbc_distances: compute periodic boundary condition aware distances between atom pairs given edge indices and lattice parameters
preprocess_crystal_csv: preprocess a CSV file of crystal structures in parallel to build graphs and extract symmetry information
